label: Sport — Discipline Study
description: The craft rather than the contest: technique held at the point where it is hardest, shot clean enough to read the form. Closer, quieter and more instructional than the action frame, and it works as well for a kata as for a reformer. No venue slot: the discipline states its own environment, and an independent venue draw produced a tennis serve in a skate bowl.
